_prior_art: PRIOR ART: none — looked in scripts/eval/estimator/router-table/ (dated builds and rules.json only; nothing names the live table) and scripts/lib/ocr-routing-table.json (hand-edited production routes, not the k/n decisions).
_doc: The router table whose decisions are LIVE (#7809). Lanes read it at start (scripts/lib/router-binding.mjs) and page when they run another route than a cell's keep/switch decision. Moving `table` to a newer build is the act of deciding; scenario tables stay what-ifs. `cells` moves the pointer for the named cells only ({cell: {table, set, why}}: that cell's row comes from that build, every other cell from `table`), so a decision about two cells does not carry every other change a rebuild makes. A waiver lets one cell run another route: {cell, lane?, set, until (at most 14 days after set), reason}. An expired or undated waiver counts as none.
